source.title: General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher System
source.author: J. Rives Childs
source.source_image_note: The complete source page and this crop were directly inspected. The crop is retained locally and reproduced from the pinned public source PDF; no new image asset is required in this text-only edition.
visual_findings: The source body has 224 slots: 44 five-position groups and the four-letter final XDVV.
Group 16 is GGVVX, with five coordinates; earlier OCR GGVVXX added one unprinted X.
Group 21 is XGG--: the two printed dashes occupy source 103 and 104.
The header prints 2 TL and RICHI-224. No other part of this message is identified in this edition.

earlier_ocr_comparison.scope: OCR diagnostic only, not a source frame adopted by the edition.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Source: J. Rives Childs. Earlier repository OCR remains preserved. Current source restoration and explicit editing: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: The source contains exactly its advertised 224 slots; no insertion, deletion, source reordering or changed key is used.
KARTE and GLEIWITZ each require one observed-coordinate substitution. SALZBURG and LEMBERG each supply one printed erasure. These are lexical choices, not unedited received text.
The trailing VF and XA cells are distinct unassigned cells whose globally injective labels are 5 and 6. Mixed or independent completions are not permitted.
The literal footer 1D70??, FS and AOK11 are not normalized or interpreted as a precise administrative number.
Only a second part is present. No missing first part, sending office or successful shipment is reconstructed.
